mapper.sql: id, name, type, teacher_id, score, num, room, week, segment, status
mapper.insert: insert into course (name, type, teacher_id, score, num, room, week, segment, status) values (#{name}, #{type}, #{teacherId}, #{score}, #{num}, #{room}, #{week}, #{segment}, #{status})
mapper.select: select c.*, t.name as teacherName from course c left join teacher t on c.teacher_id = t.id where c.id = #{id}
select from course where teacher_id = #{teacherId} order by id desc

SELECT c.*, t.name as teacherName FROM course c LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id JOIN student_course_enrollment sce ON c.id = sce.course_id WHERE sce.student_id = #{studentId} AND sce.status = 'ENROLLED' ORDER BY c.id DESC

SELECT c.*, t.name as teacherName FROM course c LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id WHERE c.status = '即将开课' OR c.status = '进行中' AND c.id NOT IN ( SELECT sce.course_id FROM student_course_enrollment sce WHERE sce.student_id = #{studentId} AND sce.status = 'ENROLLED' )
AND c.name LIKE concat('%', #{courseName}, '%')
ORDER BY c.id DESC
